description: Stake and emission concentration analysis for a Bittensor subnet: top-1 share, top-10 share, and the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI = sum(s_i^2) where s_i is percentage share 0-100, or normalized 0-1) across neurons. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_tao_subnet_validators when you need top validators of a specific Bittensor subnet by stake; crypto_tao_subnet when you need Detailed pool metrics for a single Bittensor subnet.
